description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named EmployeeEventSearchFilterParams in the OrangeHRM project. It extends a base FilterParams class and encapsulates search filter parameters for employee events, such as employee number, date range, type, and event. The class includes getter and setter methods for each property.

classes.name: EmployeeEventSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO for filtering employee event searches, including employee number, date range, type, and event.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter parameter.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter parameter.

methods.name: getDateRange
methods.description: Returns the date range filter parameter.

methods.name: setDateRange
methods.description: Sets the date range filter parameter.
